<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-adapters.mjs — do not edit manually. -->
Follow `standards/security.md`, `standards/backend.md`, and `standards/database.md`:

- Keep `Route -> Service -> Data Access` separation; return explicit DTOs without `passwordHash` or `tokenHash`.
- Enforce session auth (`401`), role permissions (`403`), verified session `organizationId` filtering, cross-tenant FK ownership checks, and strict Zod validation rejecting mass assignment (`role`, `ownerId`, `organizationId`, `tenantId`).
- Validate `Origin`/`Host` on cookie-authenticated mutations (`403`), bound pagination (`1 <= limit <= 50`), and redact secrets/tokens/cookies from structured logs.
- Use parameterized Drizzle queries, UTC `TIMESTAMPTZ`, integer minor units/`NUMERIC` for money, transactions for multi-step mutations, and versioned SQL migrations (`drizzle/`). Never run `db push` or `seed` in production.
- Verify changes with negative tests against real migrations (`npm run fullstack:test`).
